'''Torhaa Phaa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He trained in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], and sometimes dueled a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]]. He wielded an orange-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The lightsaber is comprised of a metal hilt with an s-curve emitter and a series of vertical blade grips encircling the lower part of the hilt.

==Behind the scenes==
Torhaa Phaa, like [[Frey Suun]] and [[Florg Nerfherder]], was an NPC in the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|Clone Wars Adventure]]. Like the other two, he served as a stand-in duelist in multiplayer [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duels]] when another player could not be found. He could also be seen training under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]].
